productConcept.name: Kesslar & Vane
productConcept.description: A precision scientific instrument workshop hand-assembling theodolites, spectrometers, and measuring instruments in Edinburgh since 1887 — each piece numbered, each commission accepted by brief.
productConcept.rationale: Cormorant Garamond weight 800, near-black/white palette, and restrained 34px gutter demanded a product world of exacting craft. Precision instruments answered the aesthetic signal. The Edinburgh address grounds the fiction in a city with a legitimate instrument-making heritage.

color-system.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim. Pure white page background (#ffffff), near-black body/heading text (#050505). Luminance: 255 — qualifies as light register.

type-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Heading font weight shift. h1 and h2 fontWeight increased from 600 to 800 (+200 steps, intensity 3). Cormorant Garamond at weight 800 gives the display headings a more authoritative press-weight character while retaining the serif's editorial refinement. All fonts confirmed on Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Duration scaling (slower) ×1.3. All numeric duration values multiplied by 1.3. Primary transitions: 1s→1.3s, cards: 0.4s→0.52s, shadow cards: 0.6s/1.2s→0.78s/1.56s, icons: 2s→2.6s, tracker opacity: 0.5s→0.65s, dot transitions: 0.3s→0.39s, ambient rotation: 60s→78s, pulse: 4s→5.2s. Creates an unhurried, deliberate motion character.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Container padding change +12px (intensity 3). paddingInline increased from 22px to 34px. section-width adjusted from 1420px to 1372px. The wider gutter gives content more lateral breathing room within the 1440px max-width frame.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Section-specific breathing room, intensity 3. Section paddingTop/Bottom increased from 72px to 104px (+32px). Section paddingRight/Left increased from 56px to 88px (+32px). Only section element modified; all other spacing unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist A: Hover transition speed — more languid, intensity 3. All hover transition durations increased from 0.2s to 0.35s (+0.15s). Creates a more considered hover response that complements the 1.3× scaled motion system.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist E: Item spacing change — more spread, intensity 3. itemSpacing increased from 24px to 34px (+10px). The wider nav item cadence opens the top bar horizontally, reinforcing the editorial and inscriptional character of the typography system.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift. One paragraph in Section 3 (Media Composition and Art Direction) rewritten to foreground the tactile and physical qualities of the art direction — the weight and grain of the image surfaces, their calibration to the space they coexist with. The analytical structure of the document is preserved; the tone of one section now emphasizes material specificity over compositional observation.

consistencyChecks.checkA_colorContrast: PASS — navText #050505 (brightness ~5) vs navBackground transparent/#ffffff (brightness 255): sufficient contrast. bodyText #050505 vs pageBackground #ffffff: sufficient contrast.
consistencyChecks.checkB_motionInteractionCoherence: PASS — hover transitions 0.35s vs primary motion range 0.39s–1.3s. Ratio ~3.7× well within 5× threshold.
